title: The Infinite Power Oceans in Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem
body:
Allah, Allah, Allah Subhaanallah, Allah, Allah, Allah Sultaanallah. La ilaaha illa-Llah. La ilaaha illa-Llah. La
ilaaha illa-Llah Muhammadun Rasoolullah. Habeebullah, Noor al-`Arshillah. Allahuma zidhu `izzan wa
sharafan nooran wa surooran, sultaanan wa ridwaana. W 'arham da`fana, yaa Rabbal-`izzati wa'l-Azhamati
wa'l-jabaroot. Madad yaa Saahib al-Imdaad. And we are asking support from Qutbu 'l-Mutasarrif on this
planet. May Allah grant you much more honor and power.
We are saying as-salaamu `alaykum to our attenders from ins, Mankind, and from jinni. And we are saying
a`oodhu billahi min ash-shaytaan ir-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'rRaheem is giving us power here and Hereafter. Say Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem at least 100 times a day. You will find
according to your believing, honor and power, every time you are say, bismillahi'r-rahmani'r-raheem.
Endless treasures you can find in Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem. All people will be regretting on the Day
of Resurrection why they are not saying more, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem. Why? And they will look
and see and feel and understand the powers and honors coming to people who are saying, Bismillahi 'rRahmaani 'r-Raheem.
O People! If you are sitting and not working, not doing anything, then you may say, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'rRaheem. Everything by itself is going to run on its real majra channel and you will be at rest and happy, no

need to use anything. Everything you will find already prepared for you in this short time of your life.
O our Salafi `ulamas! Where are you ? Is it true or not, what we are saying? Saheeh am laa (correct or not)?
You can't say kabarta shuwaywa ziyaadah (and even more), wa ziyaadah, wa ziyaadah, nu'min bihi (we
believe in it)! Say, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem, our sword that lam yughlab, was never defeated, the
sword from heavens! Say, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem! If, all our `ulamas and learned people from
every religion speak on the fawa'id holy benefits granted Man in Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem, from the
beginning of life on this planet up to the end, they will never finish it! Perhaps they will say only one little
spot from the benefits of Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem! (Mawlana Shaykh sings.) Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani
'r-Raheem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.
If you are hungry (and you recite this), you will get food. If thirsty, you will reach satisfaction. If asking to do
something and saying, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem, it is going to happen without using technology. If
people know what is that secret power through Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem, they will put this
technology in the WC (toilet). Qul aamantu billahi, "Say, 'I believe in Allah.'"
O Salafi `ulamas! Don't say, Shaykh kabbar aw shaykh kabartaa, "Shaykh exaggerated." Therefore, now we
must come back to spirituality. We must throw away technology and materialist aspects. You are wasting
your precious life to be Shaytan’s servants, because Shaytan is bringing that technology in existence, and who
is running after it is going to be a slave of Shaytan. True or not? Yes. Don’t speak anything, `ulamas of Azhar
ash-Shareef and shaykhs of this and that; leave them. Speak on it. Never-ending meanings may come, but
you are only going to bring one small centimeter and asking to put in it oceans or seas! If you are asking for a
cup of milk and the milk seller says, “Where is your cup?” and ladies present a thimble and say, “Put in it one
liter of milk,” what it will be? (exaggerated a bit).
You may say the same as what the shaykh said. Open your heart more and more, and open your
understanding more and more, and prepare yourself more and more to move with such a power from the
oceans of Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem, never ending! But people are slaves of technology. Sayyidina `Isa
(a) was using Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem and saying to a dead body, “Stand up!" and the dead body
came alive and got up, yes. Laa tashuk, don’t be doubtful for what we are saying. No! We can’t say anything,
and we are using the smallest and smallest and smallest power of Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. If one

holy one who has been granted the secret power for this planet is standing up and kicking this planet, and
saying, "shoot!" this planet is going out of its orbit and never coming back. Khalifatullah.
O `ulamas, and all Mankind! You must try and come to your beliefs. You left beliefs granted to you from
heavens, and you fell in the sewage channels of this dirty life, and you lost your chance. That is your fault!
Therefore, say, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.
O `ulamas! When Allah Almighty created the Preserved Tablet and the Holy Pen, the Holy Pen stood up and
asked, "O my Lord, (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) I am going to write on the Preserved Tablet, Bismillahi 'rRahmani 'r-Raheem." (Mawlana Shaykh sits.) The first command of Allah Almighty for writing on the
Preserved Tablet; what was he writing? Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem! And you can't imagine the speed,
according to the high command of Allah Almighty, just he wrote Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. How long
did it take to write Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem? According to heavenly knowledge reaching holy ones, it
took 700 years! But those years (are not like our years); can’t be, because it is not good to say that the Holy
Pen using 700 years in the Divinely Presence. He (swt) knows only, and His majestic and glory-granted
mighty servant and His mighty and majestic representative knows what those 700 years are.
And Allah Almighty granted to His servants when they are saying Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem, from His
endless Favor Oceans, like 700 years, running to that man, as a servant for him! Therefore, people will not
regret, but they will be nadmaan, regretful, "Why are we not saying this too much?" And only granted before
the Seal of Prophets (s) for some prophets, as Adam (a), for his repentance to be accepted. For repentance he
recited, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. And with Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem His Lord gave His
mercy and accepted Adam's repentance and then with Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem he was taken up.
Granted once to Nuh (a), and he said Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem Bimillah majreeha wa mursaahaa. He
used Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem once and he was saved, then Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem, just
taken up. Then coming for saving Sayyidina `Ibraheem (a) when he had been thrown in fire of Nimrod,
Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem saves him, just coming up. Then when then coming for Sulayman (a) to be
king of Man and jinns, taken up and not left on Earth. Then granted to Moses (a), when he had been ordered
to pass from the Red Sea, from one side to the other side, granted and taken up. Then ordered for Jesus
Christ (a) when he had been ordered to rise up, granted Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem and then when
saying, and going up.

The only nation to which Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem is granted is Ummata Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana
Shaykh stands and sits.) And we are lucky ones because our nation is perhaps the most beloved one in the
Divine Presence. We are happy. And granted the power of Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem, only awliyas,
they have knowledge, and granted that karamaat, miracles that awliyas using, for the benefit of the nation of
the Seal of Prophets (s), saying Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. Without Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem
they can’t do anything and that is with us! We may say Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.
O Salafi `ulamas! Why you are quarreling, fighting with something that has no meaning? Leave everything
and speak on the fada'il, benefits of Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem granted to ummat al-Habeeb, from
honor and heavenly power. Heavens yahkum, all heavens control everything on Earth. Therefore, who is
saying, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem is quickly going to be in connection with heavenly powers. And
tooba, thumma tooba, good tidings, then (further) good tidings to those people who are knowing the value of
Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem and saying it. Without Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem everything is
abtar, without any result. Such things they are doing without using Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem, so
there are no results. Real results are with those who are saying, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. Such a
things they are doing and it will have no meaning, if they leave saying, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.
O People! O `ulamas! We are addressing from east to west, from north to south, to all nations: say, Bismillahi
'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem! That means yata`allaq bil-kull, “It is related to all.” Even an atom must reach
something from that ocean to be in existence. It is mentioned in Holy Qur'an:
••••••• ••• ••••••••••• ••••••••• •••••• ••••••• ••••••••••• ••••••••••
Innahu min Sulaymaan wa innahu Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem, Verily it is from Solomon, and is (as
follows): 'In the name of Allah, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.' (27:30)
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Power comes like rain, raining, raining, raining. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.) People
lose that and everything is going to be `aqeem, impotent. Such a tree you are putting in a pot with water will
have no result until you are planting (with soil). Therefore, everything now that western people are so proud
of is nothing. If one from Chosen Ones from heavens is saying, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem, making like
this (waves hand), nothing will act, nothing will work, and their technology will be finished. May Allah forgive
us.

O People! Try to be servants and try to be munaasib, suitable for reaching those endless treasures from
Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem is for opening locked hearts, for opening
blocked heads, and opening everything that is difficult for treating. It is enough, and more than enough!
Here they are making me to speak on very, very, very short meanings or wisdoms from power and lights and
honor; it is only one small point from an endless ocean. Try to reach more. Your life is going to be abaadi, a
holy, sweet life, where you can go, where you can be found, and you will find a sweetness! Your life is going to
be a sweet life, here and Hereafter. Don’t ask, but people are just cheated by shaytans. And Shaytan is making
people to be under a heavy burden from technology. Everything that Shaytan is asking a man to do, just
saying bismika Allahuma, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem, and just happening. But they are just taking
as`ab, most difficult ways to reach that point, and that point they can’t reach.
O People! Say, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem! (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'rRaheem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. Yaa Rabbana ighfir lana, yaa Rabbana bi-jaahi nabiyyika 'lkareem ij`alna mu`mineen wa aamineen bi barakati habeebika 'l-kareem, that You sent to him Bismillahi 'rRahmani 'r-Raheem. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Fatihah.
(Mawlana Shaykh prays two raka`ts shukr.)
Fatihah.
(38 minutes.)
